examples.explanation: Strings starting with '1' come first, then the remaining single digits.
With only two values, dictionary order matches numeric order.
Single-digit values keep their natural order.

hints: Think of numbers 1..n as a ten-way tree where each value x has children x*10 .. x*10+9.
Walk that tree depth-first: go deeper with x*10 when possible, otherwise step sideways and climb past trailing 9s.
Keep a single cursor and emit one number per step instead of sorting strings.
title: 462. Lexicographical Numbers
